title: A message on a request thread, either direction

template_code.description: A code from catalogs/chat-templates.v1.json; null for free text

free_text_allowed.description: Institution side only: whether the borrower may now reply in free text

description: A message in the per-lender thread of a request (thread = request_id + institution_id). Structured messages carry template_code + params, and body must equal render_chat_message(template_code, params, sender_side); receivers re-render and reject a mismatch. Free text (template_code null) is only for the institution whose offer the borrower accepted. Never carries a person's identity: no borrower account id, no staff id.
